title: Pharmacy Sales Consultant - Queens, NYC
description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve - we care.
What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
Company Profile
McKesson Corporation is a global leader in healthcare supply chain management solutions, retail pharmacy, community oncology and specialty care, and healthcare information solutions. McKesson partners with pharmaceutical manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, governments, and other organizations in healthcare to help provide the right medicines, medical products, and healthcare services to the right patients at the right time, safely and cost-effectively.
United by our I2CARE shared principles, our employees work every day to innovate and deliver opportunities that make our customers and partners more successful - all for the better health of patients. McKesson has been named a “Most Admired Company” in the healthcare wholesaler category by FORTUNE, a “Best Place to Work” by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation, and a top military-friendly company by Military Friendly. For more info, visit .
We take pride in our culture of connection and believe in a workplace where everyone can be their full, authentic self. We welcome and encourage veterans, individuals with disabilities and others with diverse perspectives to join our growing team. Your unique perspective and experience are valuable assets that can translate into a rewarding career path with us.
Job Description
We are seeking a Pharmacy Sales Consultant.
The Pharmacy Sales Consultant (PSC) is an individual contributor sales professional responsible for the selling of our portfolio of products and services into community pharmacies within an assigned geographic territory. The PSC is a highly consultative role requiring the ability to effectively lead all interactions with the pharmacist in charge and/or business owner of the pharmacy. The PSC will develop the appropriate strategy for each assigned account, prospect, and lead the coordinated execution of various products and services throughout the sales process. The PSC will position McKesson as a trusted and expert partner. This is a field-based position with daily customer and prospect facing responsibilities within the region, so extensive travel with some overnights required.
The Pharmacy Sales Consultant focuses on retaining independently owned community and Alternate Site pharmacies through a high level of customer satisfaction and cultivating the customer through in-depth growth strategy and Enterprise Solutions within our portfolio of products and services. The Pharmacy Sales Consultant also uses a robust knowledge of our value proposition to win new, profitable business. As a sales consultant, it is vital to understand the current industry and customer opportunities or challenges and well as have a collaborative relationship with peers and cross-functional departments to provide guidance and expertise to the customer. The territory for this position will be Queens, New York. The ideal candidate will live in the New York City area.
Key Responsibilities

• Achieve annual budget objectives for assigned sales territory.

• Build a comprehensive business plan to optimize short- and long-term territory performance.

• Lead the execution of a consultative sales process from qualification to contract negotiations for all opportunities within assigned territory.

• Build a robust opportunity funnel by organic (cold calling) and coordinated efforts.

• Skilled in territory planning, forecasting, and pipeline management with rigor and precision.

• Consistent track-record of quota over-achievement and top performance.

• Proven success in upselling, cross-selling, and maximizing customer lifetime value.

• Strong communication skills with exceptional storytelling and presentation abilities.

• Experience with Salesforce and modern sales tools.

• Knowledge of EUC, VDI, UEM, or DaaS solutions is a plus.

• A proactive, growth-oriented mindset with a passion for innovation and problem-solving.

title: Account Executive
description:
Description:
SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!
Position Summary:
We are seeking an Account Executive to join our Sales Team. In this quota-carrying and fast-paced role, the Account Executive will continuously seek net new business derived from prospecting, territory management, and periodically going onsite. This position will pull in resources from the sales engineering team and work to transition business to our implementation team. Once a new customer is onboard, this account will remain as part of the territory for possible upsell or cross sell. The Account Executive will grow business with a constant mix of new and expanding clients with a strong emphasis on net new customer acquisition.

It is a 100% Direct Sales role.

Essential Responsibilities / Duties

• Ability to align sales efforts with internal teams and leverage relationships to generate new opportunities.

• Customer-centric mindset with a focus on building long-term relationships.

• Team player with a collaborative approach, capable of working cross-functionally with various departments.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Uri
description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Uri dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: VP Strategic Alliances (Databricks & Snowflake)
description:
Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts
Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.
What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office
We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.
The Role
As the VP Strategic Alliances (Databricks/Snowflake) , you will serve as the commercial lead for our newly forming AI and Data practice. This is a high-impact, dual-focus role combining enterprise alliance relationship management with direct, quota-carrying sales execution. Operating in a high-visibility, ground-floor environment backed by private equity, your day-to-day will involve navigating partner ecosystems, creating an efficient co-sell engine, and directly closing transformation deals with enterprise CMOs, CROs, and data leaders. Working hand-in-glove with our technical architecture leadership, you will gather critical market intelligence, establish marquee client logos, and directly shape the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy as this high-growth practice scales.
Responsibilities

• Alliance Ownership: Own the strategic alliance relationships with Databricks and Snowflake, building a robust and repeatable co-sell engine.

• Pipeline Generation & Execution: Build, manage, and close a pipeline of platform-led front-office transformation work within enterprise accounts.

• Quota Attainment: Consistently carry and meet defined commercial sales quotas for the practice.

• Practice Shaping: Formulate the commercial GTM strategy, partner programs, and competitive positioning within the data and AI ecosystem.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with the technical Architecture Leader to accurately scope, architect, and win complex enterprise deals.

• Market Intelligence: Synthesize and deliver early market insights regarding data platform trends, competitor blind spots, and client demand to leadership.

• Strategy & Thought Leadership: Champion Bluprintx ’s global AI point of view, positioning the consultancy as a premier market leader in AI-driven transformation. Guide multinational enterprises on the strategic convergence of their modern data architectures (Databricks/Snowflake) and their executive AI roadmaps, establishing the macro-level vision for next-generation commercial growth.

Requirements

• Direct Ecosystem Experience: Proven track record of direct sales experience within either the Databricks or Snowflake platform ecosystems.

• Alliance Mastery:Demonstrated success managing strategic partner or alliance frameworks within enterprise technology or management consulting environments.

• Quota Performance: A verified history of carrying and exceeding enterprise-level sales quotas.

• Ecosystem Knowledge: Strong familiarity with cloud data ecosystems; specialized knowledge of AI and machine learning capabilities within Snowflake/Databricks platforms is highly preferable.

• Ambition & Ambiguity Resiliency: Comfort entering an agile, high-growth practice during its early incubation and funding phases.

title: Lead Product Manager, Connectivity / Gateways
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Verkada's Connectivity products secure people and property in remote and edge environments. Our Cellular and Wi-Fi Gateways bring Verkada's full platform including threat detection, deterrence, and real-time visibility, anywhere it's needed. Verkada Gateways enable cameras, intercoms, access control, and sensors to be deployed in locations without stable internet or power.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and grow Verkada's Gateway product line. In this role, your mission is twofold: make gateways the enabling layer that unlocks every unwired Verkada deployment, and build the product depth and business model that grows Gateway into a flagship product.

What You'll Do

• Own strategy and execution for Verkada's Gateway product line

• Own and expand the gateway roadmap across reliability, fleet-scale cloud management, and new connectivity options and form factors.

• Partner with product lines across Verkada (remote cameras, security trailers, transportation, intercoms, access) to deliver connectivity-as-a-service and drive ecosystem attach

• Define data plan and pricing strategy that improves both customer adoption and Verkada margin

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B networking, connectivity, embedded systems, or IoT

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field. MS, PhD, or MBA optional

• Proven history of launching and scaling products and businesses. Strong customer intuition, technical depth, and ability to navigate tradeoffs are critical to success in this role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, WAN failover, SIM/carrier management), plus foundational knowledge of firmware, device bring-up, and hardware design

• Ability to build platform and recurring-revenue business models, with a structured approach to ambiguous problems like data plan pricing, carrier economics, attach-rate modeling, and ROI analysis

• Excited to roll up your sleeves and get out of the office. You'll spend time with installers, integrators, and customers deploying in unwired environments. You’ll use that insight to shape the product

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs. Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision, and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexib

You are…

• Data-oriented and able to gather data to guide decision making and find opportunities for improvement.

• Experienced in equipment selection, design, standards, performance improvement, statistics.

• Able to work as part of a team and interact effectively with others.

• Able to analyze and provide solutions for cost reduction through automation implementation and cost/benefit analysis.

You have… 

• BS Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or similar field required.

• AutoCAD proficiency required

• Hands-on mechanical aptitude and an ability to understand how equipment and systems operate.

title: Production Editor
description:
Production Editor
Location: Remote
A production editor serves in a variety of capacities to prepare editorial content for Hearst Newspapers print editions, including:

• Page layout and section organization

• Wire news decision-making

• Copy editing for print

• Page editing, including headline and caption writing, photo selection and trimming stories to fit.

• Proofing pages

• Typesetting pages in time for deadline.

Depending on the size of the newspaper, depth of editing and other factors, the production editor may perform all of these tasks for a page, set of pages or a section; or play one or two of these roles on a section or set of pages. Often, production editors will serve in one or two of these roles for part of a shift, and in other sets of these roles for another part of the shift.
Being flexible, adaptable and able to flex between the roles and vary the depth of editing and finishing is a crucial part of this role.
Key qualifications

• Page layout and section organization.

• Copy editing, including headline writing and caption writing

• Savvy to finish and typeset a page on time

• Experience in print news production

• Ability to work with multiple products and multiple people with a customer-service focus.

Specialty Skills

• Newspaper editing, headline writing and caption writing

• Aptitude in sports story and page editing a plus

• Newspaper page proofing

• Excellent literacy in English

• CUE/CCI experience plus.

Special to this role
While we are looking for editors who can work across topics, this role will primarily be focused on editing and presenting sports news in the Hearst papers throughout Texas, especially focused on Dallas, Houston, San Antonio and Austin.
As such, sports journalism is a specialty sill that is necessary for success, as will the ability to work in other parts of the operation outside of sports.
About Hearst Newspapers:
With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate.
At HNP , we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories - growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms - to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.
Be a part of something bigger - your headline awaits.

Wayve’s Embedded Automotive Platforms team builds portable, production-grade core libraries and standardized APIs at the boundary between our autonomy stack and real vehicle platforms. Its work enables Wayve software to run reliably across automotive reference platforms and runtime environments, including NVIDIA DRIVE Orin on Linux/QNX and Qualcomm platforms.

- Technical and organisational foundations that allow the EAP team to scale.

- Reliable software components used by internal teams, OEM programmes, and external partners.

description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Step into a  highly strategic Director-level role as the company’s NAND Industry Subject Matter Expert . You will be responsible for developing and maintaining a deep, forward-looking view of the NAND industry and using that expertise to help shape the company’s  five-year NAND strategy .

Working closely with our  Sourcing organization and Business Units , you will connect external NAND industry dynamics with our product, technology, supply, cost, and growth requirements. Your perspective will help determine where the industry is heading, how supplier strategies are evolving, and what actions we should take today to secure the right technology, capacity, cost position, and supply resiliency over the next five years.

This role requires someone who has  deep credibility in the NAND industry  and can serve as the go-to expert for senior leadership on NAND technology, suppliers, economics, capacity, and market dynamics.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as the company’s NAND industry subject matter expert , providing a deep and differentiated perspective on NAND technology, suppliers, industry economics, supply/demand, capacity, pricing, and competitive dynamics.

• Help develop the five-year NAND strategy  in partnership with Sourcing and the Business Units, translating industry trends and supplier roadmaps into long-term technology, capacity, sourcing, and product strategies.

• Develop a forward-looking view of the NAND industry , including technology transitions, wafer and bit capacity, layer scaling, TLC/QLC adoption, cost curves, supplier investment plans, industry consolidation, and major changes in supply and demand.

• Assess NAND suppliers and their strategic direction , including technology roadmaps, manufacturing capabilities, capacity expansion, investment priorities, financial position, customer allocation strategies, and competitive behavior.

• Partner with Sourcing  to inform long-term supplier strategy, including supplier selection, diversification, capacity commitments, strategic relationships, commercial models, and negotiation strategy.

• Partner with Business Units and Product Management  to understand long-range product requirements and ensure the five-year NAND strategy aligns with anticipated customer demand, product roadmaps, performance requirements, and business growth.

• Build market and scenario models  to evaluate alternative industry and business outcomes, including changes in supply, demand, technology, pricing, capacity, and supplier behavior.

• Identify emerging opportunities and risks early , providing senior leadership with a clear view of structural changes in the NAND industry and their potential impact on the business.

• Provide executive-level insight and recommendations , distilling complex industry information into a clear view of what matters, what is changing, and what strategic actions should be considered.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Expert-level knowledge of the NAND flash memory industry  with a deep understanding of the major suppliers, technologies, manufacturing economics, capacity, technology roadmaps, and competitive landscape.

• Strong understanding of NAND industry

title: Senior Data Science Engineer (Canada, EST, Remote)
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Data Science Engineer to provide applied data science expertise within our Success Engineering team, helping customers maximize the value of MindBridge’s control points and ensembles. You will configure and tune existing models, assess their application to customer data, investigate model behaviour and results, and translate complex findings into practical solutions. Working primarily post-launch, you will partner closely with Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to solve complex customer needs within MindBridge’s existing capabilities.
What You Will Do
Applied model & ensemble expertise
Maintain deep working knowledge of MindBridge's core detection methodologies: scoring logic, risk indicators, and how ensembles combine individual control points into a single output. Serve as the go-to technical resource within Success Engineering for questions about how a model or ensemble actually works.
Engineering & AI/ML liaison
Maintain an active, ongoing working relationship with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to stay current on model changes, known limitations, and upcoming capability shifts. Use that relationship to bring well-informed, technically grounded context back to Product/Engineering when a configurability gap is identified, a clear technical brief on what was requested, why it isn't currently supported, and what the customer's underlying value requirement needs, not just an administrative escalation.
Configurability boundaries & value mapping
Develop and maintain authoritative understanding of how, why, and to what extent MindBridge's core models and ensembles can be configured, which parameters are flexible, which are structurally fixed, and the statistical or product reasoning behind each boundary. Map a customer's stated business value requirement onto the specific configuration options actually available, and explain in plain terms what is, and is not, achievable within the current product.
Post-launch feasibility & configuration advisory
Evaluate customer requests to add, modify, or reconfigure a control point or ensemble, and determine whether it is feasible with existing product capability and the customer's available data. Define the specific data requirements: fields, quality, volume, structure - needed to support a proposed configuration. Recommend the configuration approach that best fits the customer's control objective within supported product capability.
Explainability & customer communication
Translate model and ensemble behavior into language finance, audit, and compliance stakeholders can act on: what it measures, how it scores, and why a specific result occurred. Support customers who need to justify or defend MindBridge's outputs to their own internal or external stakeholders, a recurring requirement in audit-facing use cases.
Root-cause diagnostics
When a control point or ensemble underperforms post-launch, determine whether the cause is data quality, configuration, or a genuine product limitation, and recommend the correct fix.
Escalation & product boundary stewardship
Distinguish clearly between a configuration question and a request that requires new product capability, and route the latter through Product/Engineering governance. Do not build bespoke workarounds to cover product gaps; document and escalate them instead.
Enablement & knowledge capture
Convert recurring model and configuration questions into FAQs, decision guides, and training material for Success Engineers, Success Engineering Architects, and Delivery Services.
Bounded support to Delivery Services
Act as an internal subject-matter-expert resource for Solutions Architects and Data Engineers specifically when an implementation calls for a control point or ensemble configuration that has not been built or validated before; not for routine, previously-validated feasibility questions, which remain owned by Delivery Services. Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.

We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.

Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

 

THE ROLE:

You'll be the infrastructure and reliability engineer on the Data Replication team - a full-stack product team running over 3 million sync jobs a week powering thousands of data use cases across multiple regions and clouds. You’ll build and maintain the infrastructure, set reliability standards, drive down incidents, and make it easier and safer for engineers to ship through tooling. You're equally comfortable in a Terraform file, a Kubernetes cluster, and a postmortem doc.

We expect engineers here to actively use AI as a force multiplier - agentic tools to automate toil, augment incident response, and build smarter internal tooling. If you're not already doing this, you should be excited to start. We care as much about how you work as what you build. Trust, directness, and craftsmanship matter here.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Own the infrastructure underpinning the Data Replication platform - Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, networking, and cloud resource configuration across AWS and GCP.

- Partner with product engineers to reliably integrate product features with infrastructure.

- Maintain and enhance observability, alerting, and anomaly detection with an eye towards LLM automation.

- Maintain and enhance AI-augmented release and internal tooling: canary deployments, progressive rollouts, automated release qualification, and rollback automation - with an eye towards LLM automation.

- Set the infrastructure bar for the team - build self-serve tooling, write runbooks, and coach engineers to own more of their stack.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

- 7+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps.

- Hands-on ownership of Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform in production environments.

- Deep experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) and on-call operations.

- Experience with CI/CD pipeline ownership and developer tooling.

- Ability & willingness to read backend code to understand how systems break and instrument them correctly.

- Fluency with AI tools - LLMs and agentic frameworks to automate, debug faster, and reduce toil.

- A startup-ready mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, moving fast, and owning problems end-to-end.

 

NICE TO HAVE:

- Data pipelines, replication systems, or ETL/ELT platforms.

- Control plane / data plane architectures or internal developer platforms.

- Experience with Airbyte, CDKs, or connector-based architectures.

 

LOCATION:

- Onsite 4 days/week in San Francisco, CA

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

- Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually

- 12-16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents

title: Software Engineer - Platform Integration, Robot Software
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable.

As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations.

- Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks.

- Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution.

- Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse.

- Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance.

- Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability.

- Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services.

- Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures.

- ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration.

- Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging.

- Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride.

- Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet.

- Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust.

- You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms.

- You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration.

- You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware.

- You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation.

- You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up.

Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalize and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve

title: Network DevOps Engineer
description:
Network DevOps Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Network DevOps Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Network DevOps Engineer who blends strong Python development skills with deep networking domain expertise to automate network configuration, change management, and observability across multi-vendor enterprise networks. The role focuses on building production-grade automation using modern network APIs, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD practices that bring software engineering discipline to network operations. The ideal candidate writes idiomatic Python, has shipped network automation in production, and combines networking depth with practical software-engineering rigor. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.

• Five or more years of network automation experience.

• Strong Python development skills including OOP, testing, and packaging.

• Deep networking fundamentals including routing, switching, and BGP.

• Hands-on experience with Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, or Scrapli.

• Experience with modern network APIs (NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI).

• Strong experience with Ansible and Jinja2 templating for network automation.

• Familiarity with NetBox, Nautobot, or other source-of-truth platforms.

• Strong Git-based workflows and CI/CD experience.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Cisco DevNet or vendor automation certifications.

• Experience with multi-vendor networks (Cisco, Arista, Juniper).

• Familiarity with streaming telemetry and modern observability stacks.

• Open-source contributions to network automation projects.

• Experience with cloud networking automation in addition to on-premises.

How to Apply

title: Consultor SAP Manufacturing (PP / QM / PM)
description:
Consultor SAP Manufacturing (PP / QM / PM)
Descripción de la empresa
Cliente final de manufactura confidencial en Panama
Descripción de la vacante
El consultor SAP Manufacturing participará en la implementación y el despliegue (rollout) de Planificación de la Producción (PP), Gestión de la Calidad (QM) y Mantenimiento de Planta (PM) en
nuevas plantas, filiales o países, con base en una plantilla global. Trabajará con consultores senior, líderes funcionales y usuarios clave de producción, calidad y mantenimiento para asegurar una
configuración, validación y adopción correctas.
Responsabilidades Principales

• Participar en implantación y rollouts de SAP PP, QM y PM siguiendo la plantilla global
existente.

• Analizar los requerimientos de cada módulo e identificar brechas (fit-gap) frente a la plantilla

• PP: configurar datos maestros (BOM, hojas de ruta y recetas, puestos de trabajo, versiones de fabricación), MRP Live, MPS, órdenes de fabricación y de proceso, notificaciones y
entradas de producto terminado.

• QM: configurar características y planes de inspección, planes de muestreo, lotes de inspección, registro de resultados, decisión de empleo, notificaciones de calidad y certificados.

• PM: configurar ubicaciones técnicas, equipos, avisos y órdenes de mantenimiento, planes de mantenimiento preventivo, puntos de medida y gestión de repuestos.

• Asegurar la integración con MM, SD, CO (costos y liquidación de órdenes) y FI-AA.

• Participar en la migración y validación de datos maestros.

• Ejecutar pruebas unitarias (Unit Test), integrales (SIT) y de aceptación (UAT).

• Elaborar documentación funcional y materiales de capacitación, y capacitar a usuarios clave.

• Dar soporte en la salida a producción y la estabilización (hypercare), y resolver incidencias.

Requisitos

• Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, de Producción, Química, de Sistemas o
carreras afines.

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia en SAP.
Participación en al menos 3 proyectos completos de implementación o rollout SAP.

• Conocimientos funcionales sólidos de SAP PP y de al menos uno de los módulos QM o PM.

• Conocimiento de procesos de manufactura: planificación, producción, calidad y mantenimiento.

• Conocimientos de integración con MM y CO.

• Experiencia en pruebas funcionales, capacitación y soporte a usuarios

• Experiencia en entornos SAP S/4HANA.

• Inglés intermedio (B1-B2).

Deseable

• PP-DS (Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling): planificación detallada con capacidad finita, heurísticas, secuenciación y tablero de planificación en S/4HANA.

• DDMRP (Demand-Driven MRP): posicionamiento y dimensionamiento de buffers y planificación de reaprovisionamiento por demanda.

• También se valoran: experiencia en industrias reguladas (farmacéutica, alimentos, automotriz), mantenimiento predictivo, proyectos multi-país, la metodología SAP Activate y certificación SAP en Manufacturing.

1. About APF Canada
The Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada is Canada’s only national public‑purpose institution dedicated exclusively to Canada‑Asia engagement. Our vision is a prosperous, secure Canada shaping its future through high‑impact engagement with Asia, and our mission is to enable Canadians to understand, connect with, and succeed in Asia.
2. Background and Purpose
APF Canada is seeking a qualified UX consultant or firm to conduct an independent, evidence-based review of asiapacific.ca and to deliver clear, prioritized, and implementable recommendations for modernizing the site’s structure, usability, and visual design - without diminishing the visibility of our core research outputs, programs, and networks.

This engagement is a strategic re-design engagement. It is not an implementation contract (see Section 6).

3. Objectives
The successful proponent will help APF Canada achieve the following:

• Understand our audiences. Establish who actually uses asiapacific.ca, what they come for, and where the current experience fails them - grounded in analytics and primary user research, not assumption.

• Simplify the information architecture. Recommend a navigation and content taxonomy that is intelligible to a first-time visitor while still surfacing the full breadth of our research, programs, and networks.

• Make our research findable. Recommend search, filtering, and browsing patterns appropriate to a large and growing publications archive.

• Modernize the visual design. Recommend a contemporary, credible, distinctly APF Canada visual direction appropriate to a national policy institution - clean, readable, and confident rather than decorative.

• Clarify the digital ecosystem. Advise on the relationship between asiapacific.ca and our satellite properties.

RFP issuedOctober 22, 2026Deadline for written questionsNovember 2, 2026Answers posted to all proponentsNovember 6, 2026

November 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m. PT

The total budget for this engagement is not to exceed C$30,000, inclusive of all professional fees, participant incentives, software and research tool costs, travel, and applicable taxes.

Proponents must provide a detailed cost breakdown by phase and by deliverable. Where a proponent believes the objectives cannot be fully met within this budget, they should identify which elements they would recommend prioritizing and price optional components separately.

Proposals must not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices, CVs, and portfolio samples, and must include:

• Cover letter (1 page) - primary contact, firm overview, and a statement of interest.

• Understanding of the assignment - your reading of APF Canada’s challenge, based on your own review of asiapacific.ca. We are particularly interested in what you observe that we may not have.

• Proposed approach and methodology - including research methods, participant recruitment strategy, and how you will balance modernization against preservation of our core content.

• Work plan and schedule - phases, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.

• Team - named individuals, roles, time allocation, and relevant experience. Identify who will lead the engagement and who will conduct research and design. Note any subcontractors.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Location: Remote First; office location Moorgate, London (flexible remote working locations within UK/Europe)
Employment type: Permanent
Working Hours: Full-time (9-6 UK)
Salary: Up to £120,000 + Shares + Benefits

TransFICC is hiring a Network Infrastructure Engineer to provide high-performance, low-latency connectivity to our customers. We develop an integration service product that enables our clients to have a flexible, hosted service without requiring their internal resources to respond to connectivity challenges across trading venues.

You will be joining our SRE team and contributing to TransFICC’s culture of automation. We are a multi-disciplinary team covering everything from desktop and laptop support to data centre provisioning of servers and vendor network connectivity. 

We all have areas we are stronger in, but we all share responsibility for the entire environment. We are seeking someone like-minded who can contribute to our team while also learning from us. 

About the Role - Your mission will be:

- Research, design, deploy, and support new and existing networks, including network hardware vendors, routing/switching, low-latency technologies, telco circuits, and data centre connectivity.

- Network as Code: Develop new features, new automation and observability, and push to network new configurations and features to support our business. Ansible, Terraform.

- Support the network and the wider infrastructure.

- Interact with network vendors and circuit providers.

- Plan work in data centres.

What we are looking for:

- Need to know how to code. You don’t need to be an expert, but basic programming in your language of choice is required - you need to be able to build a program.

- Everything we configure at TransFICC is automated, so having experience with a software automation tool like Ansible and coding ability is a must.

- We are looking for someone experienced as a sys admin or network engineer; however, you must have a reasonable understanding of both.

- Constructive, open-minded and self-motivated. A belief in life learning, and an awareness of how much there still is to learn.

- Appreciate autonomy and be able to take the initiative.

- Experience managing 3rd parties via email and phone, negotiating with vendors, purchasing hardware and enabling remote work.

Ideally you would have some of the following:

- Experience in low-latency network technologies: TCP/IP, Multicast (IGMP, PIM), L2/L3, and WAN.

- Experience in deploying and supporting routing protocols such as BGP, EVPN.

- Experience with Arista or Cumulus Linux.

- Understanding of Firewall technologies, design, and vendors; and how to automate them.

- Coding experience with Python and Bash scripting to automate tasks.

- Knowledge of Ansible and Terraform to automate configuration deployment.

- Experience with Linux, both from an admin point of view and on the command line. 

- Experience in writing tests in Robot Framework.

- Well versed in observability and alerting stacks: Elastic, InfluxDB, Telegraf, Grafana

- Experience in troubleshooting system or network issues, tcpdump, wireshark, strace.

title: Junior Engineer
description:
Objective of the role
Raidiam ’s server-side team builds and runs the back-end services for Raidiam Connect, the ecosystem trust control system that digital identity ecosystems around the world rely on.

As a Junior Software Engineer you will work in the server-side team, primarily on our Java and Go services, as well as on infrastructure definition in terraform, and API definitions in OpenAPI, taking features and fixes from ticket to production with more experienced engineers around you to support you. The work is highly collaborative, the APIs we build are the contract other teams inside and outside of the company depend upon, so you will be in regular contact with product managers, UI developers and customer-facing colleagues, and with the people who operate the live environments. LLM-based coding assistants are a standard part of the team’s toolkit and will be part of yours.

Key responsibilities:

• Push new features and bug fixes into the Directory’s server-side codebases in Java and Go, taking each piece of work through refinement, implementation, automated testing and code review, and supporting release to production.

• Actively learn and adopt the technology and tools defined by the team, building genuine working fluency in both primary languages.

• Use LLM-based coding assistants as a routine part of how you work and take full responsibility for everything you submit: understand it, test it, and be able to explain and defend it in review.

• Write and maintain the automated tests, database migrations and API specification changes that go with your work, so that a change is finished when it is safely in production rather than when it compiles.

• Learn quickly from the engineers around you and consistently step up when it is required, and as you find your feet, proactively support other team members and help them to be successful.

• Contribute to code reviews as a junior engineer, to both help your learning process and because extra attention on our deliveries is always good.

• Help keep the products you contribute to healthy: investigate defects raised against them, help diagnose problems in deployed environments, and escalate clearly and early when an issue is beyond your scope.

• Take an active part in planning and estimation, and communicate progress, risks and blockers clearly.

Essential skills and qualifications

• Experience writing server-side code in at least one of Go or Java in a professional, academic, open-source or substantial personal-project setting, together with the demonstrated appetite and aptitude to become productive in the other.

• A working understanding of relational databases and SQL: able to read a schema, write basic queries and reason about a data model.

• Comfortable with HTTP and REST APIs

• Writes automated tests as a normal part of completing a piece of work, not as an afterthought.

WHAT MAKES YOU STAND OUT

title: Read These Phrases Aloud (Paid Data Task, Remote, Contract)
description:
ABOUT KLED
Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.
We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.
We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.
We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.
Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:
• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors
• Processed 5M uploads per day
• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more
Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

This listing is for one paid task in the Kled app: "Read These Phrases Aloud". There is no interview and no minimum hours: download the app, open the task, and you are paid per accepted submission.
What you will do
We show you a phrase. Read it out loud and record it.
Steps

• Read the phrase shown on screen

• Tap record and say it naturally

• Wait a beat before and after so nothing gets cut off

• Submit and move to the next

What gets rejected

• Do not start speaking before the recording begins

• Do not read in an artificial accent

• Do not record with music or TV in the background

Accepted: Complete phrase, clearly audible, no clipping at the start or end.
Pay
$0.10 per accepted recording. At a typical pace of about 20 seconds per recording, that is about $18 per hour. A 20-minute session of about 60 recordings pays about $6.00. Up to 100 recordings per session. You are paid per accepted submission (piecework, independent contractor); submissions that break the rules are not paid. Payouts are made in the app (PayPal, Venmo or a Solana wallet).
Where and when
Open worldwide: the task runs in 100+ countries. Remote, on your own schedule. Independent contractor, piecework; this is not an employment position.
What you need

• An iPhone running iOS 18.6 or later (the Kled app is iPhone-only right now)

• 18 or older

• A quiet enough place to record (unless the task says otherwise)

How to start

• Download Kled from the App Store: (also at kled.ai/app).

• Create your account and open Tasks.

• Search "Read These Phrases Aloud", read the brief and follow the on-screen steps.

• Submit. Accepted submissions are paid in the app.

Every submission is reviewed, and you opt in to a commercial training license on each upload; accepted submissions are licensed to AI labs. Questions: .
